name: Ouma Mana
source:
[spoiler]Older sister of [url=/c13846]Shuu[/url], the protagonist of the anime series. Mana is the first person to contact the "Stone of the Beginning", she also was the first to be infected by the Apocalypse virus. Mana is the cause of "Lost Christmas" incident on December 24, 2029, as she had unleashed the virus and set it out of control.

[Translated from [url=http://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/lost_x/character/other/]official site[/url].] [/spoiler]
